verdict.rationale: Stagehand ships a built-in `agent` primitive that turns high-level tasks into fully autonomous browser workflows, with a configurable model, custom instructions and max steps. Its docs also cover using the agent as a fallback and caching agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts. That is genuine task delegation to a built-in AI agent, though it is invoked through code rather than an interactive assistant. Missing for 10: agent documentation only appears in v3 docs with no v4 confirmation, no interactive in-product assistant surface, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent task delegation.
